question: What are the titles and paper ids for papers written in affiliation with Harvard University?
schema:
tenant=spider_aan_1
tables:
  - Affiliation
      affiliation_id: int — affiliation id
      name: str
      address: str
  - Author
      author_id: int — author id
      name: str
      email: str
  - Author_list
      paper_id: str — paper id
      author_id: int — author id
      affiliation_id: int — affiliation id
  - Citation
      paper_id: str — paper id
      cited_paper_id: str — cited paper id
  - Paper
      paper_id: str — paper id
      title: str
      venue: str
      year: int
relationships (many → one; joins are added automatically):
  - Author_list.affiliation_id → Affiliation.affiliation_id
  - Author_list.author_id → Author.author_id

  - Citation.paper_id → Paper.paper_id

system_sql:
WITH paper_affiliations AS (
  SELECT `author_list`.`paper_id`, `affiliation`.`name`
  FROM `workspace`.`aan_1`.`author_list`
  JOIN `workspace`.`aan_1`.`affiliation` ON `author_list`.`affiliation_id` = `affiliation`.`affiliation_id`
  WHERE `affiliation`.`name` ILIKE '%Stanford University%' OR `affiliation`.`name` ILIKE '%Columbia University%'
)
SELECT p.`paper_id`, p.`title`
FROM `workspace`.`aan_1`.`paper` p
JOIN (
  SELECT `paper_id`
  FROM paper_affiliations
  GROUP BY `paper_id`
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT `name`) = 2
) pa ON p.`paper_id` = pa.`paper_id`
